body:
Generalized anxiety disorder had almost driven me to the point of suicide. I could no longer stand waking up with panic attacks and being freaked out by things that normal people could so easily handle.
I'd been on paxil and urbanol...they didn't really work apart from making me feel sedated. But the anxiety was still there, below the surface.
Now I'm trying bromazepam. It's only been three days but for the first time in my life I can just sit, and chill out, without anxiety coursing through my veins.
It's something so many people take for granted, and now I'm finally experiencing it.
Time will tell whether bromazepan will completely solve my problems, and addiction could be an issue. But for now I'm content being the normal, happy adult I always wanted to be.
